name: 2+E
purpose: Use the already-measured six K4 core-edge gauge receipts as a stronger temporal witness so a repeated center frame alone cannot legitimize recovery.

round_receipt.absolute_edge_values: gauge-state dependent and not interpreted as logical syndrome
round_receipt.temporal_use: compare complete edge histories and exact K4 cycle validity across rounds

edge_algebra.meaning: An ideal complete edge receipt lies in the K4 cut space. Absolute receipt depends on gauge state; cycle validity does not.

state_machine: Run mandatory rounds R1 and R2 using the unchanged 39-two-qubit-gate round block.
Any center flag or detected ancilla loss -> HOLD. Any detected data loss -> QUARANTINE.
For each round, record the four center bits and all six edge-parity bits; compute the three frozen K4 cycle checks.
Fast path: if rho1 = rho2 and both edge receipts are cycle-valid, recover from the common center frame and ACCEPT. Do not execute R3.
Any flag/ancilla loss in R3 -> HOLD; data loss -> QUARANTINE.
Accept only if complete rho3 exactly equals one and only one cycle-valid prior receipt among {rho1,rho2}; recover from the matched receipt's center frame.
If rho3 matches neither prior valid receipt, or if no prior receipt is cycle-valid, HOLD.
No post-recovery verification round is present in v0.2.
stronger_than_v0_1: all six K4 edge-gauge bits must temporally agree on the accepted receipt
three exact cycle parity checks reject internally inconsistent edge measurements
edge values remain typed gauge receipts and are not relabeled as stabilizer syndrome

fault_semantics.edge_measurement_q_faults: now enter the temporal receipt rather than being ignored for recovery control
fault_semantics.edge_data_error_response: X/Y components on K4 core sites flip incident Z-edge parities according to exact symplectic commutation
fault_semantics.initial_gauge_state: arbitrary; first ideal edge round projects a valid K4 edge receipt. Replay may set an arbitrary valid baseline e0=000000 because only relative flips and cycle validity affect the controller.

evaluation_freeze.two_event: exact exhaustive over mandatory-mandatory plus triggering-mandatory/resolver event pairs under adaptive exposure
evaluation_freeze.primary_acceptance_metric: protected logical class after recovery; accepted dressed residual reported separately
evaluation_freeze.target: reduce or eliminate the v0.1 resolver's excess second-order accepted-logical coefficients without adding quantum measurements
evaluation_freeze.stop_rule: If epsilon_L_given_A has larger degree-two coefficients than 2+0 in every nonnegative p/q direction, AUTO_FREEZE v0.2 as no-go for the intended quality target.
